metadata_caption: Reminiscing about the cutest giraffe in the world and his 3 week stay here at Wandas Wee Zoo. This little guy had a rough start when his mama decided she didn’t want to be a mama but he did not let that get him down.  He was sooooo tiny but soooo brave. He is doing great at his amazing forever home. He looks like a stuffed animal and he’s still a big teddy bear at over a year old #❤️ @🦒Wildlife Vet Services🦏  #wandasweezoo #baby #giraffe #adorable #animal #animalvideos #zoo #rehabilitation #nonprofit #lovemylife #💕
